notes.title: Update Ver 1.3.0
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.3.0[/b]

[list]
[*] An autosave function has been added. The game will be automatically saved as you progress, allowing you to enjoy a more comfortable gameplay experience. When autosave is in progress, a message will appear in the bottom right corner of the screen indicating that the game is saving.

Autosave will occur at the following times:
[list]
[*] When the story progresses
[*] At the end of a normal battle
[*] Just before fast travel or warp movement
[*] When opening a treasure chest
[*] When using the item shop or tarot card facilities
[/list]
You can still use manual saves at save points and quick saves at any location as before. Autosave only saves in one place, so we recommend that you also use manual saves in parallel.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/93fa30e86c1e8381c9c5eda1a108b7199a9048c1.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Parts of the save/load screen have been color-coded to improve visibility.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/425f58cf3c34a92afddc287b677de4e4c6e80caa.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the tree in the center of the another world area to be displayed incorrectly.
[*] Other minor corrections were made.
[/list]

notes.title: Collection Introduction
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! As you progress in Half-Baked Girls, you gradually unlock galleries that you can access from the menu.

[h2]Collection[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The Event Gallery is a collection of various images used in the game. Here, you can browse event CGs, background images, item art, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/52ac1a3cb3bca2c9cf4cf7be467d8c51e7e2932f.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
In the Music Gallery, you can listen to the music used in the game. Browse the collection to enjoy each beautiful track.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/cc12da4ece9a8660d521987c4600c9cda4c5014d.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
If you happen to forget the story in the middle of gameplay, don't panic! All events are recorded in a journal that can be viewed at any time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/36f03ff3596de1ae3cc83be759a3d1ab1268bb0b.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
In addition, you can rewatch cutscenes in Replay Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/83413cf78ac8b0cc1952b2cb2671a994a4e998f0.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
In the Ghost Encyclopedia, you can see the data of enemies you have defeated. Look into your opponents' weaknesses and what items they drop to get through battles efficiently!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/d04ea2abacc01d0539f5c49be5c9d434c7eac166.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
The collection grows as you progress through the game. Be sure to collect everything and aim for 100% completion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/7bb7aa32f6f1e1e94113d5d207b6588a06829ae8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Tarot Cards Introduction
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Here's how the tarot card system works in Half-Baked Girls.

[h2]Tarot Cards[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
You can get tarot cards from chests placed throughout the area. Sometimes you can obtain them through defeating enemies or from receiving them from other inhabitants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/3ef0980b974b4d0748936a0f28f145f29dce4b39.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
There is a mysterious presence in the mansion that claims to be the "Tarot Master." The Tarot Master has the ability to unleash the power of Tarot Cards, which bestow new powers to Renee and Mitka.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/22c911a6388397f6a9b67fb34c872e0ef1098249.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
The Major Arcana cards give you magic powers. You can fight using a variety of magic depending on which cards you equip. There is a limit to the number of cards you can carry, so strategize which magic you want to use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/27d2024409da811a4af05308cad0a5c382543485.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Equipping Minor Arcana tarot cards will provide buffs to characters. The effects vary depending on the card. Consider your character's traits and choose the card that suits her best.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/dbf5309f9f67c8e6cf613628633f21c1b3869c7e.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
There are 22 Major Arcana and 56 Minor Arcana cards to discover, totaling 78 cards. Every card has a unique illustration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/768fcec6af302899659aa73f79214bd9324ecd01.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Tarot cards change your strategy in combat. If you choose your cards well, you will be able to fight against strong opponents. Try a variety of card combinations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/928ff9d89cd673dc885031feac0532e1ead0fb63.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1872430/

notes.title: Battle System Introduction
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Let's learn about the battle system in Half-Baked Girls.

[h2]Battle System[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
There are many evil spirits wandering around the halls of the mansion. You instigate a battle the moment you run into them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/61f054e0e7d9e5e2ac7c5d86eb4f90f3e2a5fc88.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
The battles are turn-based. Once it is your team's turn, you are able to decide on actions such as attacking or using items.
You can also choose what automated pattern of actions you want the girls to take in battle. By doing this, you can get through battles more quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/21ea2bbdecfcd4348875b1998ca1c595aa478123.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
The two girls can use special skills and magic that come with various effects. However, skills and magic can not be used if there is not enough MP, so pay attention to your remaining MP at all times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/2fb64bc2467a86ceb9d50addc4b02348a97f690f.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Even if you are facing only a few enemies, don't let your guard down! Sometimes other evil spirits roaming the nearby areas can jump into battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/9ffe5ce84e4b76bae947639eb2f6ffc2e9bc549b.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Renee and Mitka gain experience points by winning battles. Their levels increase if they gain enough experience, which boosts their stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/5e840fff0e15f846104b783f2316b49511366f0d.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
The enemies become stronger the more you explore the mansion. Earn money by winning battles, then buy powerful weapons and armor to defend yourself against enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/6d35e74a3f42d7285d9ff6060aa68e4e7d901d3b.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
There are powerful foes waiting for you at the end of each chapter! Make the most of the combat experience you will gain along the way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/c4579da0fc5a383acbca146bc4de34a24a03fcd6.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Win and gain experience so Renee and Mitka can overcome their dire circumstances!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/a8e452a297ff535612b7de793454f57efab80de1.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Game System Introduction
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! I'm MISTROLE, an solo indie developer.
Half-Baked Girls is a role-playing game that emphasizes storytelling.
Here's how the game progresses.

[h2]Game System[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
This game is set in a large, sprawling mansion. Renee, one of the main characters, is a girl who is searching for a way to escape the building. Many mysterious events happen throughout the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/5b75ee3db0263415d01835099c1b7deea5971c68.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Renee meets a lone survivor in the mansion, a girl named Mitka. Together, they join forces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/20518b8a9ef7fdbc14c94dedc7aca696bb183ee4.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Otherworldly inhabitants lurk in the corridors. If you talk to them, you may find clues to continue your adventure.
Sometimes, you get requests from the mansion's residents. You can choose to accept or refuse them. However, by accepting the requests, you will uncover each resident's story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/e94ce1802119b02816911edd4dd8daa47d099dab.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
This mansion will not allow you to explore its halls without putting up a fight. Its corridors are overrun by many evil spirits.
Renee and Mitka are just ordinary girls. Nevertheless, if you are brave enough to stand your ground, you can gain experience and level up, gain a variety of skills and magic, and fight more powerful enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/a7174e73178a28a836421b4bf9d4b28a8ecea449.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
When you are just beginning your adventure, you are only strong enough to explore a few areas. As you gain more power through experience and move through the story, you will be able to explore a wider area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/1de45e4ed63a5dd237d3c8bd02bb4e038234cfe7.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Explore every nook and cranny to make your escape from this terrifying place!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42407915/34931088fa4e3594068e8e4ecc0c74c1ad6b8bf1.jpg[/img]
